market_outlook.short_term: Markets face a tug-of-war: strong jobs data supports rate-hike bets pressuring equities, while Waller's dovishness and AI capex provide support. Oil at $97 creates inflation overhang. Expect S&P 500 range-bound 5,800-6,100 with elevated VIX. Energy outperforms; consumer discretionary lags. Crypto volatile but trending up. Key risk: any Iran escalation pushing oil past $100 triggers broad risk-off.
market_outlook.long_term: AI capex cycle (Nvidia, OpenAI, Tesla, Alphabet) supports 12-18 month equity upside if execution delivers. However, oil-driven inflation may force Fed to maintain restrictive policy longer, compressing multiples. Energy transition and North Sea approvals add supply. Private credit stress may normalize by Q1 2027. Consumer recovery depends on wage-inflation gap closing. Structural AI adoption (GPT-6, Cybercabs, Waymo) is a 3-5 year secular tailwind.
